To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the efficiency improvement pathway for a sustainable firm can be found by solving the problem that minimizes the sum of the production costs and the costs of the environmental impact of production.

(a) the efficiency improvement pathway for the industry and the firms can be calculated by introducing capacity constraints and (b) that the sustainable efficiency improvement pathway can be used to determine the most efficient firm in the industry.

(a) a sustainable efficiency frontier exists for a firm, (b) the sustainable efficiency frontier is a function of the sustainability target, (c) the sustainable efficiency of a firm is a decreasing function of its sustainability target, and (d) the sustainable efficiency is a decreasing function with respect to the sustainability target.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to increase the sustainability of firms and industries by increasing the efficiency of their production process.
the question how the efficiency of firms can be increased when new sustainability targets are introduced.
the question of how the sustainability targets of the earth system can be translated into the efficiency targets of firms, such that they are both sustainable and profitable.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the sustainable efficiency of firms when new sustainability targets are introduced is the maximum of the sustainable efficiency of the firm without new sustainability targets and the maximum of the efficiency of the firm with new sustainability targets.

the efficiency of firms in an industry can only be improved if they can increase their market power, and that this market power is a function of their relative efficiency, the elasticity of demand and the degree of competition in the market.
the sustainable efficiency of a firm can only be improved when the sustainability targets are introduced and the firm is willing to invest in new technologies to reach these targets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are looking at how firms should change their behavior in order to be sustainable.
a firm can be considered sustainable when it is operating in a sustainable environment.
the introduction of new sustainability targets will lead to a decrease in efficiency of the industry, which can be compensated by the introduction of new technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to take into account the capacity constraints of the earth system, and that the current economic system can be more efficient when these constraints are respected.

the introduction of sustainability targets can be a profitable business strategy for the firms involved, as the introduction of new capacity constraints can lead to a higher profit for the firm, while simultaneously increasing the efficiency of the system.

the sustainability of an industry and its individual firms can be enhanced without compromising their profit maximization, and even increase their profits, when the capacity constraints are taken into account.
